thesis: Machine-proposed candidate (app.evolution). Tests a 9/20-day EMA crossover trigger inside a 50-day SMA regime filter on QCOM, TSM, AMZN, ORCL, SMH, DVY, NFLX, INTC, MSFT, NVDA, with a 14% stop and a 92-session time stop. Never scored before being written -- this is falsified if the crossover-inside-regime signal fails to beat this purpose's benchmark by more than the measured ordering-noise floor, across whatever windows it is actually run against.
entry: close > sma(50) and ema(9) crosses_above ema(20)
